tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find companies by name, ticker symbol or ISIN. Returns up to 5 matches (symbol, isin, companyName). Use the symbol or isin with get_company_insider_trades.

tools.name: get_recent_insider_trades
tools.description: Most recently published insider transactions (SEC + BaFin), newest first, with headline text and a link. Requires limit and/or time=24H.

tools.name: get_company_insider_trades
tools.description: All insider transactions of one company (unified SEC/BaFin history), oldest to newest. Pass symbol OR isin.

tools.name: get_insider_trades_summary
tools.description: Per-company aggregates (buy/sell volume, insider counts, transaction count) over a time window, restricted to an index. authority=bafin filters DAX/MDAX (Germany), authority=sec filters SP500/DOW (US).

tools.name: get_featured_insider_trades
tools.description: Curated per-company lists shown on the home page: most-popular (highest buy volume, well-known companies), top-by-officers (highest officer buy volume), most-active-by-officers (most insiders trading).

tools.name: get_insider_toplist
tools.description: Insider performance toplist (/insider page): companies ranked by how well their insiders traded over the window.

tools.name: get_insider_barometer
tools.description: Insider barometer: buy/sell ratio gauge for a market (US = SEC universe, DE = BaFin universe).

tools.name: get_trade_volumes
tools.description: Total insider trade volumes (charts on the overview page) for a market.
